name: cmd_faces_unnamed
description: Unnamed Faces (command `faces.unnamed`). Params: {limit?: 600} → {total, faces: [{photo, index, rect, view, suggestion: {name, score} | null}], ordered, ready} — the faces nobody has named; with recognition running, look-alikes are next to each other and a face the named ones recognise carries the name they suggest. `view` is the box to show the face by. Name them with `faces.nameFaces`.
